Three tools

Work it out before you ask anyone

These run entirely in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere, nothing is stored, and there is no email field — because the point is your answer, not your address.

Which vehicle?

Six questions on activity, ownership and staff. You get an indicative vehicle, or an argument for waiting.

Run the chooser

What does year one cost?

Registration, address, accounting, audit, payroll and the buffer most founders forget.

Open the calculator

What arrives offshore?

Corporate income tax, withholding tax and treaty rates on a dividend — and the cost of other routes out.

Model a dividend

These are models, not advice. They will not tell you what a city will approve or what a bank will accept; they will tell you what a decision costs under assumptions you choose — which is the part you control.
